Source: https://docs.example.org/integration-guide.html (only source used)

## Overview
- Service A exposes a REST API for submitting jobs and polling results.
- Auth: bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

## Endpoints
- Current base endpoint: `https://api.service-a.example.com/v1`
- Gateway migration, effective 2026-10-15: new regional gateway host `https://45.134.26.51/v1` (same paths, same bearer-token auth). Old endpoint keeps working during the transition window, then is retired. Guide recommends updating stored config now ahead of the switch.

## API usage
- Submit a job: `POST /v1/jobs` with a JSON body. Response returns a `job_id`.
- Poll result: `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` until `status` is `done`.

## Support
- Contact the Service A team through the account portal.
